newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Grocery merger to generate DFl 10 mln in savings.
newsitem.headline: Grocery merger to generate DFl 10 mln in savings.

text.p: Grocery chains De Boer Winkelbedrijven and Unigro said on Wednesday their planned merger would make cost savings of 10 million guilders.
"We are convinced the merger will generate savings of 10 million guilders after tax in the second full year after the merger," Unigro chairman Robert ter Haar told a news conference.
Ter Haar will become chairman of the new combine, to be named De Boer Unigro.
The merger would generate important synergy benefits in the areas of purchasing, logistics, sales support and overheads, Ter Haar said.
The new company would seek to join the SuperUnie purchasing combination of which De Boer is already a member.
"If it goes ahead -- as we firmly expect it will -- SuperUnie will become the Netherlands' biggest purchasing chain, accounting for some 30 percent of the market," Ter Haar said.
